    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">robotframework-aitester---向robotframework中引入大模型能力</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>1.简介</h2>
<p>robotframework-aitester 是一个用于跨网络、API 和移动流程的自主 AI 驱动测试的 Robot Framework 库。通过结合 Strands Agents SDK 与原生 Robot Framework 库的复用，它允许测试人员指定测试内容，而不是手动编写每个交互细节。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="1iL5-1776737937547">2.安装（Python &gt;=3.10，robotframework&gt;=6.0）</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 基础安装
# 包括 OpenAI</span>-, Gemini-, and Ollama-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">compatible model support
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester

# 支持 web 测试
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[web]

# 支持 API 测试
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[api]

# 支持 mobile 测试
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[mobile]

# 支持所有测试模式
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[all]

# 支持 Bedrock
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[all,bedrock]

# 支持 Anthropic
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[all,anthropic]

# Development
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-aitester[all,anthropic,bedrock,dev]</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>推荐的生产环境安装：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[web]     基于Selenium的UI测试
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[api]     基于RequestsLibrary的API测试
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> robotframework-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">aitester[mobile]     基于Appium的移动端测试

基础安装已通过 strands</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">agents[openai,ollama,gemini] 包含 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Ollama 提供者的支持
仅在您选择的 GenAI 后端需要这些可选提供者时，才添加 [anthropic] 或 [bedrock]</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="7CJ8-1776738368806">3.快速入门</h2>
<h3 id="uXhs-1776738390495">前置条件</h3>
<ul>
<li>对于确定性网页运行，在使用 SeleniumLibrary 调用 Run AI Test 或 Run AI Exploration 之前，需先打开目标浏览器。</li>
<li>对于确定性移动端运行，在使用 AppiumLibrary 调用 Run AI Mobile Test 或 Run AI Exploration 之前，需启动 Appium 服务器、设备或模拟器，并打开应用程序。</li>
<li>对于 API 运行，需在测试套件中加载 RequestsLibrary，并在适当情况下提供 base_url 或已初始化的会话上下文。</li>
<li>安装针对目标模式和提供者的必要扩展。</li>
<li>如果 SeleniumLibrary、RequestsLibrary 或 AppiumLibrary 使用别名导入，请传递相应的 selenium_library 、 requests_library 或 appium_library 构造函数参数，以便 AITester 可以附加到现有会话。</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="FQDw-1776738417075">Web 测试</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>*** Settings ***<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Library    SeleniumLibrary
Library    AITester    platform</span>=OpenAI    api_key=%{OPENAI_API_KEY}    model=gpt-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">4o

</span>*** Test Cases ***<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
AI Login Flow Test
    [Documentation]    AI agent autonomously tests the login functionality
    Open Browser    https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">myapp.example.com    chrome</span>
    ${TEST_STEPS}=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Set Variable
    ...    Test Steps:
    ...    </span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Open the login page
    ...    </span>2. Attempt login <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">with</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> valid credentials and verify success
    ...    </span>3. Attempt login <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">with</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> invalid credentials and verify error message
    ${status}</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Run AI Test
    ...    test_objective</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Test the login functionality including valid credentials,
    ...        invalid credentials, empty fields, and password recovery flow
    ...    app_context</span>=E-commerce web application <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">with</span> email<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span>password login
    ...    test_steps=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${TEST_STEPS}
    ...    max_iterations</span>=50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Log    ${status}
    [Teardown]    Close All Browsers

AI Exploratory Testing
    [Documentation]    AI agent freely explores and tests the application
    Open Browser    https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">myapp.example.com    chrome</span>
    ${status}=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Run AI Exploration
    ...    app_context</span>=E-commerce platform <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">with</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> product catalog, shopping cart and checkout
    ...    focus_areas</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">navigation, search, product filtering, cart operations
    ...    max_iterations</span>=100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Log    ${status}
    [Teardown]    Close All Browsers</span></pre>
</div>
<div>　　由 Open Browser 打开的浏览器会被代理重用。如果会话已经处于活动状态，AITester 将重用它并拒绝打开新的会话。</div>
<div>　　当提供编号为 test_steps 的步骤时，这些步骤被视为主流程，并按顺序直接执行，无需单独的规划交接。</div>
<div>　　这些步骤被视为意图检查点，而不是像素级完美的脚本。只要请求的业务流程保持完整，代理可能会插入最小的支持操作，例如关闭 Cookie 横幅、打开菜单、等待页面稳定或遇到临时拦截器后重试。</div>
<div>如果流程遇到硬性障碍，代理不会停止并等待人工干预。它会首先尝试通过 get_rf_variable 获取套件提供的数据、安全的替代可见路径以及证据捕获，然后精确地失败被阻塞的步骤。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<h3 id="oRTq-1776738510239">API 测试</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>*** Settings ***<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Library    RequestsLibrary
Library    AITester    platform</span>=Ollama    model=llama3.3

*** Test Cases ***<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
AI REST API Test
    Create Session    api    https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">api.example.com</span>
    ${TEST_STEPS}=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Set Variable
    ...    Test Steps:
    ...    </span>1. Create a user via POST <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span>users
    ...    2. Fetch the user via GET <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span>users<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{id}
    ...    </span>3. Update the user via PUT <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span>users<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{id}
    ...    </span>4. Delete the user via DELETE <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span>users<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{id}
    ${status}</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Run AI API Test
    ...    test_objective</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Test the user management API endpoints including
    ...        CRUD operations, authentication, error handling, and edge cases
    ...    base_url</span>=https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">api.example.com</span>
    ...    api_spec_url=https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">api.example.com/openapi.json</span>
    ...    test_steps=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${TEST_STEPS}
    ...    max_iterations</span>=30<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Log    ${status}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="q37G-1776738539719">Mobile 测试</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>*** Settings ***<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Library    AppiumLibrary
Library    AITester    platform</span>=Gemini    api_key=%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{GEMINI_API_KEY}

</span>*** Test Cases ***<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
AI Mobile App Test
    Open Application    http:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">localhost:4723/wd/hub</span>
    ...    platformName=Android    app=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">com.example.app
    ${TEST_STEPS}</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Set Variable
    ...    Test Steps:
    ...    </span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Complete the onboarding flow
    ...    </span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Navigate to the main dashboard
    ...    </span>3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Open settings and verify key options
    ${status}</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Run AI Mobile Test
    ...    test_objective</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Test the onboarding flow, main navigation and settings screen
    ...    app_context</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Android banking application
    ...    test_steps</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${TEST_STEPS}
    ...    max_iterations</span>=40<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Log    ${status}
    [Teardown]    Close Application</span></pre>
</div>
<div>　　对于移动端测试，AITester 需要一个活跃的 AppiumLibrary 会话，并且当 app_context 和编号的 test_steps 能够明确目标屏幕、账户状态和预期路径时，效果最佳。现在它能够等待加载指示器、处理常见的选择器、隐藏屏幕键盘、切换混合上下文，并使用返回导航，而无需降级到原始的 Appium 命令。</div>
<div>　　对于移动探索性测试，导入库时使用 test_mode=mobile ，然后调用 Run AI Exploration 。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>

</tr>
<tr>
<td data-cell-id="YFCo-1776738629125">
<div class="table-cell-line">appium_library</div>
</td>
<td data-cell-id="GJdr-1776738629128">
<div class="table-cell-line">AppiumLibrary</div>
</td>
<td data-cell-id="cqcI-1776738629131">
<div class="table-cell-line">AppiumLibrary 已有会话的名称/别名</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-cell-id="v36l-1776738629135">
<div class="table-cell-line">timeout_seconds</div>
</td>
<td data-cell-id="ZmSR-1776738629139">
<div class="table-cell-line">600</div>
</td>
<td data-cell-id="iI1O-1776738629142">
<div class="table-cell-line">配置 SafetyGuard 超时元数据</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-cell-id="XSOX-1776738629146">
<div class="table-cell-line">max_cost_usd</div>
</td>
<td data-cell-id="e7y0-1776738629149">
<div class="table-cell-line">None</div>
</td>
<td data-cell-id="jUMx-1776738629152">
<div class="table-cell-line">配置 SafetyGuard 成本限制元数据</div>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div>　　如果你使用别名导入 SeleniumLibrary/RequestsLibrary/AppiumLibrary，请传递相应的 *_library 参数，以便 AI 工具连接到已打开的会话。</div>
<div>　　对于 platform=DockerModel ，AITester 会自动将 api_key=dummy 传递给兼容 OpenAI 的 Strands 客户端。对于该平台，无需设置环境变量或构造函数参数。</div>
<div>　　对于 platform=Manual ，请自行提供与 OpenAI 兼容的端点详细信息，通常需要同时包含 model= 和 base_url= ，如有需要，还需包含 api_key= 。</div>
<div>　　重要提示：AITester 只能驱动由 SeleniumLibrary/AppiumLibrary 创建的会话。如果你手动打开浏览器/应用或通过其他工具打开，代理将无法与其交互。</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<div>&nbsp;</div>
<h2>6.优势</h2>
<ul>
<li>可以以传统 SeleniumLibrary、RequestsLibrary、AppiumLibrary 为主，辅以 AI 能力，在不改变已有脚本的情况下加入 AI 能力</li>
<li>定位器易写的元素仍以常规方式编写，不易写的定位器可以使用 AI 能力辅助</li>
</ul>
